title: zl.rot

messages.description: performs the operation again on the last received list
rotation, positive to the right, negative to the left

arguments.description: rotation, positive to the right, negative to the left

methods.description: clears the mode's arguments and the data received in both inlets
sets the maximum list size, 1 to 32767

body: [zl.rot] rotates a list: with a positive rotation 'n', the elements shift 'n' positions to the right and the last 'n' wrap around to the start; a negative 'n' rotates the other way. The argument or the right inlet sets the rotation.
